statement: The HPN-QA benchmark in NetBench has 242 open-ended questions, 233 of them scored, generated from 175 open-access publications and graded on correctness, completeness, clarity, and conciseness. The study runs 8 open-weight models from 1B to 27B parameters across up to 8 adaptation variants (instruct baseline, LoRA and full supervised fine-tuning, continued pre-training, and retrieval) plus 3 frontier API baselines, scored by two independent LLM judges, with a two-expert human study validating the primary judge. The design and statistical protocol were fixed before analysis, and `make reproduce` regenerates every reported number from the committed judged outputs on every push.
